description: React component for an invitation modal in Mattermost, handling user/channel invitations, search, and UI states.

classes.name: InvitationModal
classes.description: React component class for managing the invitation modal UI, state, and interactions.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, restoring focus and calling onExited callback.

methods.name: toggleCustomMessage
methods.description: Toggles the custom message input visibility.

methods.name: setInviteAs
methods.description: Sets the invite type (member or guest).

methods.name: toggleGuestMagicLink
methods.description: Toggles the guest magic link option.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Performs the invite action based on current state and props.

methods.name: inviteMore
methods.description: Resets the view to invite more users/channels.

methods.name: channelsLoader
methods.description: Loads and filters channels based on search term and invite type.

methods.name: onChannelsInputChange
methods.description: Updates channel search input in state.

methods.name: usersLoader
methods.description: Loads user profiles based on search term.

methods.name: onChangeUsersEmails
methods.description: Updates selected users or emails in state.

methods.name: onUsersInputChange
methods.description: Updates user search input in state.

methods.name: getBackdrop
methods.description: Determines modal backdrop behavior based on current state and permissions.
